fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Fires a heavy link that deals 9 damage. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Drag Chain
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 30 damage, ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Bound Plate
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 25 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightened Mail
fusions.desc: When you take damage that is not fire, the strands cinch into a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
